name: FastStone Image Viewer
price: Free for personal and educational use; commercial US$34.95 one-time, family US$69.95 (5 PCs)
engine: Own decoders plus Windows WIC (HEIC); internal video player on Windows' codecs
summary: FastStone Image Viewer is a long-running Windows image browser with an Explorer-like folder tree, a polished full-screen mode with fly-out panels, and many editing and batch tools. It also plays videos through Windows' codecs and keeps tags and ratings in its own database.
where_it_wins: Editing tools: curves, levels, clone stamp, healing brush, red-eye
Compare up to four images side by side
Batch convert and rename, contact sheets, printing layouts
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs natively on the Mac (Apple silicon)
Plays MKV, WebM, AVI itself with built-in VLC, no codecs to install
Subtitles, audio tracks, skimming videos with the arrow keys
Archives and comics as folders (FastStone needs its separate paid MaxView for that)
Search names through all subfolders, also with regular expressions
Dual pane with F5/F6 and undo of file actions
Free for everyone including business use, open source, sandboxed, never online

free.note: Free for personal and educational use; commercial licence US$34.95 (family licence US$69.95 for 5 PCs)

dark_light_setting.note: Three built-in themes: Bright, Gray, Dark

folder_browsing.note: Explorer-like browser with folder tree and thumbnails, no import

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnail browser with folders (option Folders in Browser); whether folder tiles show image previews is not documented

recursive_search.note: 'Search by Name' (7.8) filters the current folder; no documented subfolder search

regex_search.note: 'Search by Name' (7.8) filters the current folder by name; regular expressions are not mentioned in the history

network_shares_fast.note: Thumbnail database and pre-scan; changelog notes 'improved performance on network folders'

multiple_windows.note: Dual instances: two viewers at once (since 5.8)

bookmarks.note: Favorites menu and shortcuts for favourite folders

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC (via Windows WIC codecs), AVIF (7.8), WebP native (8.1), JPEG XL (8.4)

img_raw.note: CR2, CR3, CRW, NEF, ARW, DNG, ORF, RAF, RW2 and more

img_animated.note: Animated GIF yes; animated PNG/WebP not documented

keyboard_paging.note: Keyboard and mouse wheel browsing in full screen and window

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom, magnifier, rotate, best fit / actual size

slideshow_recursive.note: Slideshow option 'Auto-Play Folders' plays across multiple folders; videos play in slideshows (6.3)

auto_enhance_view.note: Colour and light adjustments are edits that are saved; no view-only filter

file_info_exif.note: EXIF panel, histogram, file properties (Alt+I); no video codec details documented

wrong_extension_note.note: Searched FastStone feature list and full version history; nothing found either way

video_native.note: Internal video player (since 6.3) on Windows' codecs; MP4/MOV thumbnails

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: AVI, WMV, MPG, M2TS listed; MKV/WebM depend on the codecs installed in Windows ('We do not provide video codecs')

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Video files show as thumbnails in the browser next to images

video_skim_arrows.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no keyboard seeking

subtitles_embedded.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no subtitles

subtitles_external_files.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no subtitles

audio_track_choice.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no track selection

playback_speed.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no speed control

control_bar_movable.note: Play bar auto-shows at the bottom in full screen

playlist.note: Auto-plays the next video when one ends; no playlist editor

saved_playlists.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no playlists

pip.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no picture in picture

music_mode.note: Plays audio files; music for slideshows

streaming_urls.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no streams or URLs

online_subtitles.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no subtitles

video_filters_enhance.note: The version history lists every video player feature (resume position, auto-play next, loop, play bar with time hint, plays in slideshows); no video adjustments

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Explorer integration is a 'Browse with FastStone' folder context menu; no thumbnail handler in the history

archives_as_folders.note: Image Viewer can only create ZIP files (8.2); FastStone's separate MaxView (US$19.95) is the viewer with archive support

comics_cbz_cbr.note: Not in the format list (see FastStone MaxView)

manga_two_page.note: Compare mode shows up to 4 images, but no two-page reading mode

rename_trash.note: Rename, delete, folder management in the Explorer-like browser

move_copy.note: Drag and drop to copy/move; Copy/Move to folder with keys 1-9

dual_pane.note: Two instances side by side with drag and drop between them; no F5/F6

image_editing.note: Resize, crop, curves/levels, clone stamp, healing brush, red-eye, text

library_catalog.note: Tags and 1-5 ratings kept in a database (7.6); no catalog or import

keyboard_first.note: Many shortcuts, but the full-screen workflow is mouse-driven fly-out panels

custom_shortcuts.note: Configurable mouse clicks and wheel, no keyboard remapping documented

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Shortcuts are scattered through the version history; the help file was not checked

boss_key.note: Only a Minimize button hidden in the full-screen corner (4.8); no hide-all key in the version history

no_network.note: Viewing is offline; email and Show in Google Maps / OpenStreetMap use the internet
